actions: Add child-only Unicode environment overrides to ManagedProcessSpec
Preserve Windows Job Object as the sole child-process ownership boundary
Redact child environment values from Debug output
Best-effort zero temporary secret environment buffers after use
records.reason: LB-006 requires CODING_TOOLS_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN to be injected only into the coding-tools child process; the LB-004 supervisor had no per-child environment API, while CLI secrets, plaintext temporary files, process-global environment mutation, and a duplicate process launcher were rejected.
records.evidence_ref: User instruction in active LocalBridge execution: executor may self-authorize during execution but must report authorization content and concrete actions at task completion.

actions: Require the owned root process handle to signal before WindowsProcessSupervisor reports an already-stopped, graceful, or forced stop as complete
Add a bounded typed failure when Job accounting drains but the root process handle does not signal
records.reason: LB-006 actual-runtime testing proved that Job active-process accounting can reach zero before the root process has fully signaled and released its loopback listener; returning stop success at that point is premature.
records.evidence_ref: LB-006 integration reproduction: after force_stop returned and active_processes reported zero, a new TCP connection to the coding-tools loopback listener still succeeded.
